name: FUTABallot
tagline: The platform that proved the model — now evolved into Electra
description: FUTABallot is the secure digital election platform Marvlosphere first built for Nigerian universities — the one whose architecture was later generalized into Electra. It still serves student unions, electoral committees, and university administrations that need to run credible, verifiable elections without the cost and delay of paper ballots.

features.title: Secure voting
features.body: Encrypted ballots and hardened infrastructure keep every vote confidential and tamper-resistant from cast to count.

features.title: Token-based authentication
features.body: Each eligible voter receives a unique access token, ensuring one person, one vote — without exposing personal identity in the results.

features.title: Real-time integrity dashboard
features.body: Administrators and observers watch turnout and system integrity live, making the entire election transparent and auditable.

audience.label: Student Unions
audience.desc: Credible union elections students can trust.

audience.label: Electoral Committees
audience.desc: Tools to run and audit each vote end to end.

audience.label: University Admins
audience.desc: Oversight and integrity reporting in real time.
